name: BoneProjectWiki
description: A general user-owned project knowledge base with automatic agent memory, Obsidian-style tree explorer and multi-format asset management.
author: taokoplay

en.name: Project Knowledge Base
en.description: General user-owned project knowledge base with Obsidian-style hierarchy, in-place note editor, and media/office asset management.
en.safetyNotes: Operates strictly locally within the project .bone-project-wiki directory. No cloud account or external network calls required.

zh-CN.name: 项目知识库
zh-CN.description: 用户私有的项目通用知识库，支持类 Obsidian 树形文件浏览器、纯中文 Markdown 笔记无感实时编辑、图片/音视频/PDF/Word/WPS 资产管理与外部目录实时同步。
zh-CN.safetyNotes: 完全本地运行，仅在当前项目 .bone-project-wiki/ 目录下读写文件，不向外网发送任何数据。

agentTools.name: project_wiki
agentTools.description: Read and maintain the current project's knowledge, prototypes, assets and memory.
